attempted_claim: Let phi be fixed. For prime q large, sum_{chi mod q primitive} L(1/2, phi tensor chi) = (q-1)*1 + O_{phi,eps}(q^{1-delta+eps}) with delta=1/96, the implied constant effective; with a standard mollifier of length q^{1/24} this yields at least c0*(q-1) characters with L(1/2,phi tensor chi)!=0 for c0=1/200 and all large prime q. Equivalent covering form: Lindelof-on-average (1/(q-1)) sum^* |L(1/2,phi tensor chi)| <<_{phi,eps} q^{eps} with the same delta controlling the off-diagonal error.
